CaraShellRoof_US_OB_115_1.message:
Real winter storage is one option.
This cover is built to stay on your RV, on its own spot, from fall to spring.
Heavy wet snow? Brush or shovel it off, same as you would without a cover.
$199, regular $249.

CaraShellRoof_US_OB_121_1.message:
The sides of the roof cover hang free, on purpose.
The edge drops 12 to 16 inches down the sides. Door, windows and hatches stay free.
One person puts it on and off alone.
$199, regular $249.
